metadata.title: poppy.ax: Poppy, the Personal Agent Protocol, in plain words
metadata.description: Poppy, the Personal Agent Protocol (also called PAP), gives your customers' AI assistants a valet key: they can help, but only within what each customer allows. Check whether a site is ready. An independent guide by Ora.

learn.title: What is Poppy?
learn.heading: What is Poppy?
learn.lede: Poppy, the Personal Agent Protocol, is a new open standard for how a person's AI assistant works with a company. Here is the longer version, in plain words.
learn.description: Poppy, the Personal Agent Protocol, explained in plain words: the problem it solves, how it works, where the draft stands, and how it differs from MCP, shopping and payment protocols.

setup.title: Set it up
setup.heading: Set it up, one level at a time
setup.lede: Supporting Poppy gives your customers' AI assistants a front door to your site, with only the access each customer approves. Build it in four levels and stop at any of them: each says what to build, roughly how big it is, and which checks it turns green, with links to the spec.
